context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 130 tested the new multi-file Excel import feature. The endpoint POST /api/admin/bulk-import/excel now accepts 'excel_files' (plural) as the form field name and supports List[UploadFile] for up to 20 files. Test files: /tmp/naukri_sample.xlsx (40 candidates) and /tmp/test_naukri_2.xlsx (2 candidates: Test Person A, Test Person B). The frontend correctly shows 'up to 20' in the UI and the file input has the 'multiple' attribute. File breakdown section appears when fileDetails.length > 1. Source file badge (violet) appears on candidate rows when multiple files are uploaded.
